questions.q: What should you do most in a strong discovery call?
options: Ask questions and listen for the real problem
questions.explain: Discovery is about their world, not your deck. Ask, listen, and find the problem worth paying to solve.

questions.q: A prospect says 'You're too expensive.' Best first response?
options: Explore what they're comparing it to and the value at stake
questions.explain: Price objections are usually value questions. Understand the comparison and reframe around the outcome before discounting.

options: Tying your solution to their measurable business outcome
questions.explain: Buyers pay for outcomes. Connect what you sell to the result they care about, in their numbers.

questions.q: Your pipeline is full but nothing closes. Most likely issue?
options: Weak qualification — deals that were never going to buy
questions.explain: A bloated, stalled pipeline usually means poor qualification. Be honest about which deals are truly real.

questions.q: Best moment to ask for a referral?
options: Right after delivering a clear win for a happy customer
questions.explain: Referrals flow when value is fresh and obvious. Ask when the customer is delighted, not when your quota is panicking.

questions.q: How can AI genuinely help an SDR's day?
options: Drafting tailored outreach you personalise and verify
questions.explain: AI is great for fast, tailored first drafts and research — you still add the human personalisation and judgement.

chains.title: Running a deal from first contact to close
steps: Run discovery to find the real need
Map your solution to their outcome
Close and confirm the next steps
